verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Daniel 6

No Darius in secular records for this time; Darius = Cyrus, Cambyses or (preferred) Gubaru, "Darius" perhaps an honorific; signed decrees binding on the king because he spoke for the gods; no historical example given for irrevocability; quotes Ammianus Marcellinus on Persian laws killing all kindred for one man's guilt; typology of burial and rescue
